changes: Reconciliation uses one row of account and period controls, with Add account in a separate popup for adding or removing accounts from your list.
Save records and closes the reconciliation. Supporting documents remain optional; confirmed differences can be saved with a note.
Saved records display REC-YYMM-account numbers, retain summary and ledger details, and provide Export / Print without an editable count box.
Month closing requires every listed account to have a saved reconciliation. Unrelated edits preserve completed counts; changes to that account require review.
